common.footerNotice: You received this email because you are registered on the {companyName} platform.
common.helpText: If you have any questions, please contact our support team.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email address
verifyEmail.previewText: Verify your email address to log in to MockInterviewAI
verifyEmail.title: Email Verification
verifyEmail.description: Thank you for registering on the MockInterviewAI platform. To activate your account and start mock interviews, please verify your email address.
verifyEmail.expirationNotice: The link and code are valid for {expiresMinutes} minutes.
verifyEmail.ignoreNotice: If you did not register on our platform, please simply ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Password Reset
resetPassword.title: Password Reset
resetPassword.description: We received a password reset request for your MockInterviewAI account. To create a new password, click the link below:
resetPassword.expirationNotice: The link is valid for {expiresMinutes} minutes. After this time expires, you will need to request a new password reset.
resetPassword.ignoreNotice: If you did not request a password reset, please simply ignore this email or contact support if you suspect your account has been compromised.

interviewScheduled.subject: Interview Scheduled: {scheduledTime}
interviewScheduled.title: Interview Scheduled
interviewScheduled.description: A mock interview session has been scheduled for you on the MockInterviewAI platform. Meeting details:
interviewScheduled.preparationTip: We recommend joining 5 minutes early to test your microphone, camera, and browser setup.
interviewScheduled.rescheduleNotice: If your plans change, please cancel or reschedule the session in advance in your dashboard.

interviewReminder.subject: Reminder: Interview starts in {minutesUntilStart} minutes
interviewReminder.previewText: Reminder: Interview with {partnerName} starts in {minutesUntilStart} minutes
interviewReminder.title: Interview Starting Soon
interviewReminder.description: Your mock interview is starting in approximately {minutesUntilStart} minutes. Your partner may already be waiting in the room.
interviewReminder.checklistMic: Check your microphone and volume levels
interviewReminder.checklistCamera: Ensure your webcam is working properly
interviewReminder.checklistQuiet: Prepare a quiet space free of distractions

securityAlert.subject: Security Alert: {title}
securityAlert.title: Security Alert
securityAlert.description: A security-related event was detected on your MockInterviewAI account.
securityAlert.warningNotice: If you did not perform this action, please change your password immediately and revoke all active sessions in security settings.
securityAlert.supportNotice: If you have questions, please reach out to the MockInterviewAI support team.

PASSWORD_CHANGED.title: Password Was Changed
PASSWORD_CHANGED.description: Your MockInterviewAI account password was successfully changed. If this was you, no further action is required.

EMAIL_CHANGE_REQUESTED.title: Email Change Requested
EMAIL_CHANGE_REQUESTED.description: A request to change your primary account email was received.

EMAIL_CHANGED.title: Account Email Changed
EMAIL_CHANGED.description: Your primary MockInterviewAI account email has been successfully updated.

NEW_DEVICE_LOGIN.title: New Device Sign-in
NEW_DEVICE_LOGIN.description: A sign-in to your MockInterviewAI account was detected from a new device or unusual location.
